Fetches BOL.COM invoice data via Airtable API and loads it into P&L_Masterdata with explicit sign conventions (costs negative). Handles partial month detection.
Updates the Notion financial dashboard with latest P&L metrics, KPIs, and status indicators.

key_rules: TACOS denominator = Gross Revenue everywhere (PPC ÷ Gross Revenue). Never Net Revenue.
Per-ASIN data is IGNORED — unreliable. Flat TACOS per channel only.
Never invent product names — always query Puzzlup_Product_Info (status=Selling).
2025 overhead stored as annual total in month=0 — pro-rate YTD: (ytd_months/12) × annual_total.
Supabase = single source of truth — never keep financial numbers in memory.
After every data change: run full sanity checks — CM% range, sign integrity, cashflow positivity.
ALL percentage fields stored in percentage form (e.g. 14.7 not 0.147). Every calculation MUST divide by 100.0.
P&L_Masterdata has actuals protection trigger; bypass with SET LOCAL app.bypass_actuals_protection = 'true'.
refresh_cashflow_from_pl() MUST always be called without arguments (year arg was misinterpreted as safety multiplier).
pl_monthly view: if actuals lack Net Revenue for a marketplace+month, fall back to forecast entirely — no mixing.
Costs in P&L_Masterdata must be NEGATIVE (sign convention).
complete_actual_months whitelist: only sellerboard_actual and bol_api count as real actuals.
